Generate file path and name to export compiled sensor string data

Source: R/helpers-misc.R
ss_export_path.Rd

Generate file path and name to export compiled sensor string data

Usage

ss_export_path(dat, prov = "ns", path = NULL, sub_folder = NULL, ext = "rds")

Arguments

dat

Data frame of sensor string data in wide or long format. Must include columns county, station, and deployment_range.

prov

Character string indicating which province the deployment is from. Options are "ns" (the default) and "nb". This dictates the file path for where the data will be exported on the CMAR R drive.

path

File path where sub_folder is created. If NULL (the default), this is a folder on the CMAR shared drive, dictated by the value of prov.

sub_folder

Character string of the sub_folder name (inside county folder) where dat should be exported. Default is sub_folder = "new".

ext

File extension. Default is ext = "rds".

Value

A file path for exporting deployment data, including file name and extension.

Examples

dat <- ss_compile_deployment_data(system.file("extdata", package = "sensorstrings"))
#> aquameasure data compiled
#> hobo data compiled
#> vemco data from sensor <<  547109  >> compiled: Temperature & Seawater depth

path <- file.path(tempdir(), "deployment_data")
dir.create(file.path(path, "halifax", "new"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ss_export_path(dat, path = path)
#> [1] "/tmp/RtmpVlFBmm/deployment_data/halifax/new/borgles_island_2019-05-30.rds"
